digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command registration
propositions: Advanced command parsers are currently constructed inline with mixed argparse and manual dispatch, creating duplicate grammars and 21 unsafe top-level help forms.
Parser factories must be extracted to lean, reusable modules that contain no optional runtime imports (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing).
ParseError raised by RebarArgumentParser must be caught and converted to exit code 2 with identical stderr/usage bytes as the current SystemExit(2) behavior in all migrated handlers.
Commands with custom presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve byte-identical --help output while using factory-constructed parsers.
All advanced routes must register valid parser-factory references and be deterministically generation-ready without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes.
